text.content:
Passages fork here into the Gilded heart of the Crucibles, worn smooth by traffic that wasn't always living.

GM Notes

Milestone: A sign of the floor's deeper story: a rogue homunculus conclave has been using this floor to distill something out of captives who never leave.

Hazard: A ward etched into the doorway reacts to anyone who isn't already marked as an ally (DC 15 to detect and counter).

Encounter: This room refills with a new threat if left and returned to later, on the same table used for the floor's other random encounters.
